items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: I don't know. ... I was thinking of Wheeler and Williams, which was his partner, wasn't it?

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, it's nice to have confirmation. Instead of something, say, coming from my faith all along. And also I found a napkin signed by some people from the Italian Village at 115 Columbus Avenue, San Francisco.

Oh, yeah, that was, the Italian Village was a nightclub down more or less near the North Beach area in San Francisco. And for some years, the Turk Murphy Band worked in the, I think, least and worked in the lower level of the place. They had a, you know, standard nightclub and show and restaurant up above. And the, the Murphy Band worked below. And this was at least from 1952, and I suspect a little bit earlier, until they got into the earthquake lagoon business a number of years later. ctx.x: Yeah, I was thinking of Wheeler and Williams, which was his partner, wasn't it? I don't know.
There was a Burt Wheeler who was a comedian in the movies, I thought.
